title: Laying of rules and regulations before Parliament
description: The provision requires that rules and regulations made under the Act be laid before each House of Parliament

content.what: must lay rules and regulations before each House of Parliament
conditions: as soon as may be after it is made
limitations: for a total period of thirty days
without prejudice to the validity of anything previously done under that rule or regulation

aliases: rules and regulations submission to parliament
